scope: 中文输入法合成期间暂停防抖倒计时，输入法选词完成触发 compositionend 后再启动 300ms 防抖倒计时
content: The compositionend event is fired when a text composition system such as an input method editor completes or cancels the current composition session. During composition, input events should not trigger premature commit or debounce until composition ends.
